name: Igyou Byoutou SILENCE OF THE DAMNED
original_name: 異形病棟 SILENCE OF THE DAMNED
source: Melice is a nurse working in the closed ward. The world where she is now is like a never-ending nightmare and she must escape from there.
translation: Melice is a nurse working in the closed ward. The world where she is now is like a never-ending nightmare and she must escape from there.
